get.description:
Top-level J&K budget summary for the given financial year: total, capital and revenue.
Live and official totals are never compared here: the budget table lists only some departments,
the CAG accounts all grants.

get.description: Full scheme detail with district-wise breakdown.

Time-series of spending for a scheme + run-rate projection to March 31st.

Math:
  daily_run_rate = total_utilized_so_far / days_elapsed_in_FY
  projected_utilized = current_utilized + (daily_run_rate * days_remaining)
  on_track = projected_utilized >= total_allocated

Returns all 20 districts with aggregated fund absorption scores.
Fixed: was N+1 queries (1 per district); now 2 queries total.

GrantBreakdown.title: GrantBreakdown
GrantBreakdown.description:
Where a department's (or one grant's) money went, from the grant pages of the CAG Appropriation
Accounts. The notes list only the heads with notable savings, excesses or unspent provisions,
so the head rows do not add up to the grant total; the section blocks do.

name.description: Official grant name as printed in the summary table

department_id.title: Department Id
department_id.description: Tracker department, via grant_department_map; null if unmapped

source.description: Summary-table page of the grant in the snapshot PDF

head_code.title: Head Code
head_code.description: Codes from the major head down to this node, joined by dots

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Note rows for exactly this head

HeadNode.title: HeadNode
HeadNode.description: A node of the head tree (major → sub-major → minor → sub-head → detailed head).

printed_error.title: Printed Error
printed_error.description: Set when the printed figures don't add up in the PDF itself

HeadRowItem.title: HeadRowItem
HeadRowItem.description: One row of a note table (₹ lakhs). Amounts the PDF doesn't print are null, not 0.

diff_pct.title: Diff Pct
diff_pct.description: (live − official) / official × 100; null when official is 0

MismatchInfo.title: MismatchInfo
MismatchInfo.description: Set in the combined view when the portal and the audited accounts differ by more than 2%.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Grant numbers summed (a department can have several)

recoveries_lakhs.title: Recoveries Lakhs
recoveries_lakhs.description: Recoveries deducted from expenditure (Appendix II); null if Appendix II isn't loaded

OfficialChain.title: OfficialChain
OfficialChain.description:
How a year's audited grant became spending, from the CAG Appropriation Accounts (₹ lakhs):
original + supplementary (+ re-appropriation, 2021-22 only) = final grant; final grant − gross
expenditure = saving − excess; gross expenditure − recoveries (Appendix II) = net expenditure.
The original grant is the amount passed with the budget; it has not been checked against the
Budget Estimates in the J&K budget documents, so it is not called a Budget Estimate here.

SchemeVelocity.title: SchemeVelocity

SectionBlockItem.title: SectionBlockItem
